descriptorExport: none (fixture owner; no runtime module). Consumers set ModuleDescriptor.fixtureIds to the IDs below.
fixtureFormat: { fixtureId, description, origin: 'fixture', contractVersion, contractDigest, snapshot: SnapshotManifest, batches: EventBatch[], expectations }
eventIdDerivation: sha256:<hex sha256(adapterId + U+0000 + upstreamKey + U+0000 + kind)>
sourceVersionProbe: not applicable (synthetic redacted fixtures; every event origin=fixture, sourceVersion=fixture-1)

checks.note: fixture JSON is excluded by oxfmt ignore rules

gaps: Event ID derivation separator (U+0000) is A04's choice; A03 contract only says sha256 of adapterId+upstreamKey+kind. If B-collectors or A03 standardize a different join, A04 regenerates.
expectations blocks are golden inputs/invariants derived from the data, not metric outputs; no MetricResult goldens exist because metric definitions/IDs are owned by B metric owners.
Other owners' fixture dirs (fixtures/<id>/) are not listed in index.json; they request entries from A04 (index is A04-exclusive).
Fixtures are synthetic: they prove contract/honesty behavior, not live source availability.
